A photo of the Dynamic Aviation A200 aircraft, which will conduct low-flying research flights over farmland near Transit, Texas, to measure emissions in October and November 2026. Dynamic Aviation Agricultural emissions represent an important and understudied part of Earth’s land and atmosphere systems. The FarmFlux mission will deploy more than a dozen sensors to measure ozone, methane, ammonia, particulates, and other pollutants rising from crop lands and livestock farms and their interaction with the Earth’s atmosphere. The mission is jointly led by NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland; Colorado State University; and Boston University. title: Is your Pixel recording unusually quiet audio? You’re not alone
summary: Still dealing with microphone issues first reported back in 2024.
body: TL;DR Several Pixel owners are reporting unusually low microphone volume when recording audio/video natively or via certain apps. Similar complaints date back to 2024 and span multiple Pixel generations, including the latest Pixel 10 series. Google appears to be aware of the complaints but hasn’t publicly acknowledged a widespread issue, and there’s no confirmed fix yet. Apart from offering one of the best software experiences in the Android smartphone ecosystem, Google’s Pixel line is also known for its impressive camera capabilities . However, what good is a high-res video recording if you can barely hear anything when you play it back? That’s exactly the frustration that a lot of Pixel owners are (and have been) dealing with. This isn’t a brand new issue, but it is resurfacing now. Reports about Pixel microphones recording audio that’s too quiet to hear can be traced back to 2024, and similar microphone problems appear to have continued to plague users since.

title: Amazon’s new AI note-taking hardware debuts with a wearable option
summary: Say hello to the Bee Frontier and Eclipse.
body: TL;DR Amazon has unveiled two new AI transcription devices under the Bee brand, called the Frontier and Eclipse. The Frontier is a fitness band-style device that attaches to your wrist or clothing, while the Eclipse magnetically attaches to the back of a phone. The Frontier is available now on Amazon, but the company didn’t provide a date for the Eclipse’s availability. We got an early look at the Bee Pioneer at CES 2025 , an always-listening AI assistant that attaches to your wrist or clothes for conversation summaries and insights. Bee, which has since been acquired by Amazon, has now launched two new products, including a magnetically attaching device for your phone. In a blog post published today, Amazon officially announced the Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse. The Frontier follows last year’s Pioneer and includes an “ultra-soft” silicone band you can wear on your wrist or attach to a piece of clothing.

summary: نجم إنجلترا الأول حسم قراره
body: نجم إنجلترا الأول حسم قراره توصل بايرن ميونخ إلى اتفاق مبدئي مع مهاجمه الإنجليزي، هاري كين، على تمديد عقده بعد أسابيع من المفاوضات بين الطرفين، بحسب تقرير صحفي. فقد ذكر الصحفي البريطاني البارز في شبكة "سكاي سبورتس" ، مايكل بريدج، اليوم الخميس، أن بايرن ميونخ ينجز حاليًا الأوراق الرسمية لتمديد العقد حتى صيف 2029. اقرأ أيضًا هالاند يكتسح ميسي في سباق تاريخي بدوري الأبطال رغم أفضلية ريال مدريد.. برشلونة لم يغادر السباق على جوهرة اليونايتد وانضم كين إلى بايرن قادمًا من توتنهام في أغسطس 2023، بعقد يمتد لأربعة مواسم حتى 30 يونيو 2027. ولم يكشف النادي البافاري حينها عن قيمة الصفقة، لكن تقارير إعلامية قدرتها بنحو 100 مليون يورو، وهو رقم قياسي في الدوري الألماني. وكانت تقارير ألمانية قد أشارت، خلال الصيف الماضي، إلى رغبة الطرفين في تمديد العقد، حتى صيف 2029 على الأقل. كما وصف ماكس إيبرل، المدير الرياضي لبايرن، المفاوضات بأنها متناغمة للغاية. ويواصل كين تألقه هذا الموسم، إذ سجل هدفين في تعادل بايرن ميونخ خارج أرضه مع فايكينج النرويجي (3-3)، الثلاثاء الماضي، ضمن الجولة الثانية من الدور الأول لدوري أبطال أوروبا. كما يعد النجم الإنجليزي أحد أبرز المرشحين لجائزة الكرة الذهبية 2026، التي ستسلم في لندن يوم 26 أكتوبر الجاري. ناقش الموضوعات والأخبار بشكل أعمق في منتديات كووورة

title: Google might soon borrow a sleeper Safari feature for Chrome
summary: Google is working on an effortless way to copy multiple links at once in Chrome.
body: Credit: Joe Maring / Android Authority TL;DR Google is working on a button to copy multiple links at once. Engineers are exploring a button to copy URLs for all tabs in a group with a single click. The one who proposed it says the feature could allow users to easily copy multiple source links at once and share them with an AI chatbot. AI browsers have been cropping from the left, right, and center, and to keep up with intense competition, Google wants Chrome to feel as exciting as it did at launch . This is why Google is committing to delivering new Chrome features every two weeks , and one such feature could actually make researching and working with AI interfaces much easier. Google is testing a new menu option that lets you copy multiple links at once. Based on a Chromium-related thread on Google’s Issue Tracker (via Piunika Web ), Google engineers are exploring a single button to copy URLs for all tabs in a single tab group.

title: Samsung could have two more foldable surprises in 2027, for a total of six new foldables
summary: The next Galaxy Z lineup could include a phone that doesn't fold.
body: TL;DR A new leak claims Samsung’s 2027 Galaxy Z lineup could include six devices, including a Galaxy Z Fold 9 Pro and a Galaxy Z Slide. The tipster also claims improvements in battery, thickness, and weight across the lineup, with the TriFold 2 set to arrive first. Samsung has demonstrated slidable display technology, but the six-device lineup remains unverified, and earlier reporting points to a 2028 rollable launch. Samsung had barely unveiled the Galaxy Z Fold 8 family and Z Flip 8 when reports emerged suggesting its 2027 flagship lineup could grow to eight phones , including four foldables. That already sounded ambitious. Now, a fresh leak adds two more names to the Galaxy Z guest list, and one suggests Samsung’s next trick might involve less folding and more stretching. According to tipster TheGalox on X , Samsung’s 2027 lineup will include the Galaxy Z Flip 9, Z Fold 9, Z Fold 9 Ultra, and Z TriFold 2 — the four devices in that earlier report. Joining them would be the Galaxy Z Fold 9 Pro and Galaxy Z Slide. The tipster also claims improvements in battery life, thickness, and weight across the lineup, with the TriFold 2 arriving first.

title: Bye bye One UI, hello Galaxy OS? Wild rumor points to a big shakeup for Samsung phones
summary: Samsung might be cooking up a new identity for its Galaxy software.
body: TL;DR A new rumor suggests Samsung could be working on Galaxy OS, with deeper AI integration through Google and third-party partnerships. The tipster claims One UI 10 could bring a major overhaul alongside the Galaxy S28 series. Samsung hasn’t confirmed any of these plans, and no other reliable sources have corroborated the rumor. Samsung has called its Android software One UI for years, and Galaxy users have seen it change quite a bit along the way. We’ve had visual overhauls, new customization options, and, more recently, a growing list of Galaxy AI features . But Samsung may be planning something even bigger for its next major software update, and it could come with a new name. According to an X user known as Phonefuturist , Samsung could be working on something called Galaxy OS . The tipster claims that Samsung is strengthening its partnership with Google and exploring deeper AI integration across its software. It could also partner with third-party services, some of which may be paid, though the details are still unclear.

title: Motorola Signature 27’s seven-year update promise comes with a pretty big asterisk
summary: The Signature 27 sounds like Motorola's software comeback until you read the fine print.
body: TL;DR The Motorola Signature 27 is scheduled to receive up to seven major Android OS updates and bi-monthly security updates for up to seven years. Unlike recent Pixel and Galaxy flagships, Motorola isn’t promising monthly security patches, and even its two-month cadence isn’t guaranteed. Some Motorola fans are fine with fewer, more stable updates, while others are more concerned about those two words: “up to.” Motorola’s software reputation has never quite matched the appeal of its hardware. Its phones can be fast, stylish, and packed with clever ideas, but software update support often becomes the part buyers grumble about later . The Signature 27 looked like a chance to rewrite that story, with Motorola finally putting together a proper premium flagship aimed at the same buyers considering a Pixel or Galaxy. Now we know what that phone’s software support actually looks like, and the headline sounds better than the fine print. Motorola says the Signature 27 is scheduled to receive up to seven major Android OS updates, along with bi-monthly security updates for up to seven years. That sounds generous until you start pulling at the wording.

title: Samsung Galaxy phones can’t tell if they’re connected to Bluetooth or not
summary: The Samsung Galaxy's volume slider is mixing up its connected device icons.
body: Credit: Aamir Siddiqui / Android Authority TL;DR Samsung Galaxy phone users are experiencing a strange bug affecting the volume panel. When playing audio through the phone’s speakers, a Bluetooth icon appears at the bottom of the slider. Instead of an earbud icon, a speaker icon reportedly appears when earbuds are connected. You may not always notice it, but the volume slider on your Galaxy phone conveys more information than just the volume level. Whether you’re listening to music through your earbuds or blasting it through your Bluetooth speakers, there will be a little symbol at the bottom of the panel that lets you know what your phone is connected to. However, a new bug is causing issues with this indicator. Samsung Galaxy phone users ( 1 , 2 , 3 ) are experiencing a strange glitch affecting the volume panel. When playing audio through the handset’s speakers, a Bluetooth icon appears at the bottom of the slider. That should not be happening, as it suggests the phone is connected to a Bluetooth device even though it is disconnected. Users also report seeing a speaker icon instead of an earbud icon when their earbuds are connected.

title: Survey reveals Kindle readers aren’t buying Amazon’s pricey page-turning solution

body: Credit: Amazon Physical page-turn buttons might seem like a pretty basic feature for an e-reader , but Amazon has spent years leaving them off its Kindle lineup. The company has given bookworms a way to bring them back with its latest devices, although it’s charging a hefty premium for the privilege. We recently asked readers whether they’d be willing to pay $80 for this convenience, and the results suggest Amazon might have misread the room. As my colleague Dhruv Bhutani explained in his recent look at the 2026 Kindle refresh , Amazon’s new Page-Turn Cover adds physical buttons to the e-reader through a magnetic connection. The catch is that it costs $80 and it only works with the Signature Editions of the Kindle Paperwhite and Colorsoft, which already cost $250 and $320, respectively. That makes $330 the minimum entry price if you want physical buttons on a new Kindle. We wanted to know whether you thought this was fair enough, or if perhaps Amazon should have just included this functionality as part of the deal.

summary: Sideloading is risky, but apparently so is the Play Store.
body: TL;DR A fake Google Chrome app with over 100,000 downloads was available on the Play Store. The app, from a developer named “Hizbartech,” even paid its way to the top of the search results for “Chrome.” Google has since removed the app, but it raises questions about the Play Store’s review and ad practices. Google talks a big game about trying to keep the Android ecosystem safe and secure. The company recently started cracking down on sideloading apps because malicious actors can easily create fake apps and trick users into installing them. Instead, Google wants users to install apps directly from the Play Store. The idea is that installing apps from the Play Store pretty much guarantees you won’t install a fake or malicious app. However, Google doesn’t seem to be doing a stellar job of keeping the Play Store safe, either.

Google’s Fast Pair is one of Android’s most convenient features, which lets you connect Bluetooth accessories (and verify their authenticity) without the usual hassle. It already works with a variety of accessories for your Android device, including wireless earbuds or headphones, smart glasses, keyboards, mice, styluses, etc. Last year, Google also expanded Fast Pair support to hearing aids , making them much easier to connect to your device. Now, Google appears to be working on expanding support to other health devices, such as BP monitors, smart weighing scales, and more.

title: Googlebook OS just fixed one of its biggest early app annoyances
summary: Googlebooks can now turn practically any website into an app.
body: TL;DR Chrome 155 lets Googlebook users install any webpage as a web app, even if the site lacks an installable web manifest. Installed web apps can open in their own windows, appear in the app launcher, and be pinned to the taskbar or homescreen. The update also moves Chrome Settings into a separate tab and is rolling out through Google Play over the next few days. Googlebook OS is barely out of the starting gate, but early adopters have already given Google a fairly clear homework list . Apps have been one of the biggest talking points, from some Android apps behaving differently across hardware to major Google services running as web experiences instead of native Android apps. Google now appears to be moving quickly on some of that feedback, and its latest Chrome update addresses one particularly annoying limitation. With Chrome 155, Googlebook owners can install any webpage as a web app, even when the website wasn’t specifically designed to be installable. Previously, sites without the necessary web app manifest could only be saved as shortcuts that opened in regular browser tabs.
